audit.title: Audit Log
audit.tamperSubtitle: Every event is sealed with SHA-256 over itself and its predecessor. Verification replays the whole chain live; WORM export seals yesterday's events to in-Kingdom object storage.
audit.wormScheduleNote: A scheduled job also exports yesterday's audit events daily at 02:00 as gzip NDJSON with SHA-256 metadata to object storage with Object Lock. The manual button triggers the same export on demand.
